annotations.description: Prometheus has failed to scrape /metrics for 1 minute. The process is down, restarting (supervisor backoff), or unreachable.
The engine worker panicked or hit a sticky device error; the server answers 503. The supervisor should restart the process.
annotations.summary: intarsia engine {{ $labels.instance }} reports a failed worker

annotations.description: {{ $value }} requests are in flight and the step counter has not moved. --watchdog-s turns /health 503 and the supervisor restarts it.
annotations.summary: intarsia engine {{ $labels.instance }} has work but is not stepping

annotations.description: Look at the supervisor log (watchdog, OOM, CUDA/HIP sticky errors).
annotations.summary: intarsia engine {{ $labels.instance }} restarted twice in 15 minutes

rules.name: IntarsiaTtftP95High
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(intarsia_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > 10 and on (instance) sum by (instance) (rate(intarsia_ttft_seconds_count[5m])) > 0

annotations.description: Time to first token over the last 5 minutes. Long prompts legitimately take long: check the prompt-length panel before paging.
annotations.summary: intarsia TTFT p95 on {{ $labels.instance }} is {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}

rules.name: IntarsiaItlP95High
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(intarsia_itl_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > 0.25 and on (instance) sum by (instance) (rate(intarsia_itl_seconds_count[5m])) > 0

annotations.description: Decode is slower than 4 tokens/s per stream for 5 minutes.
annotations.summary: intarsia inter-token latency p95 on {{ $labels.instance }} is {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}

annotations.description: Share of finished requests with reason=error over 5 minutes (client cancellations do not count).
annotations.summary: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of intarsia requests on {{ $labels.instance }} end in error

annotations.description: Requests queue faster than the engine drains them. At --max-queue the server answers HTTP 429.
annotations.summary: intarsia queue on {{ $labels.instance }} is at {{ $value }} waiting requests

annotations.description: The queue is full: clients are being turned away.
Long contexts or too many concurrent sequences; prefix reuse evicts and admission may refuse.
annotations.summary: intarsia KV cache on {{ $labels.instance }} is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} full
